meta.name: Heeramandi The Diamond Bazaar
meta.description: The scheming Mallikajaan rules over an elite house of courtesans — but a new rival threatens her reign as rebellion brews in British-ruled India.

videos.title: Mallikajaan: The Queen of Heeramandi
videos.overview: As Mallikajaan reigns over her courtesans, rebellion grows on the streets. Alamzeb has her first brush with love. Wali shares key information with Bibbo.

videos.title: Fareedanjaan: The Challenger Returns
videos.overview: Heartbroken by a nawab, Lajjo turns to drink and dance to win back her former lover. Mallikajaan reveals a dark secret as her past catches up with her.

videos.title: Waheedajaan - Scarred for Life
videos.overview: The return of Fareedan to Khwabgah raises tensions as Mallikajaan schemes to cling onto her control. Waheedan makes a bold move of her own.

videos.title: Alamzeb: The Innocent Pawn
videos.overview: As her dance debut approaches, Alam questions her place at Heeramandi. Saima unwittingly earns Mallikajaan's ire and Fareedan strikes back.

videos.title: Tajdar: The Lover’s Dilemma
videos.overview: As Mallikajaan and the courtesans fervently search for Alam, Tajdar comes to her rescue. Meanwhile, an enraged Waheedan has a proposal for Fareedan.

videos.title: Tajdar & Alamzeb: Nation vs. Love
videos.overview: Alam and Tajdar’s romance intensifies as a rebellion is being hatched. Mallikajaan and Fareedan uncover dark and disturbing secrets about each other.

videos.title: Bibbojaan - Long Live the Revolution
videos.overview: Cartwright’s scheme against the courtesans unfolds. Seeking a future with Alam, Tajdar approaches Mallikajaan — but her approval comes at a price.

videos.title: Heeramandi: The Swan Song
videos.overview: The fight for freedom reaches the steps of Heeramandi — for both the courtesans and the country. Will the battle end in victory or result in ruination?
